subject: Trial activation & streaming integration — success metrics, ownership, next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@bytebridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:22:00Z
Subject: Trial activation & streaming integration — success metrics, ownership, next steps

Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed activation plan for the 2-week trial we discussed. Keeping this high-level so engineering can pick up the tasks.

Key goals (success criteria)
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency <= 300ms for 512-token requests under our expected load (~5 qps).
- Cost: per-token inference cost below $0.0009 for the standard prompt mix (we'll reconcile with your finance team).
- Quality: BLEU-style pass rate on the 50 QA prompts >= 92% (we'll provide the prompt set).
- Stability: zero crashes and <=1% error rate over 48h soak.

Proposed trial scope and timeline
- Day 0 (tomorrow): share SDK guide & activation plan (attached).
- Day 2: ByteBridge spins up test integration with streaming enabled (API key and sandbox provided).
- Day 3–9: run evaluation harness; daily sample exports to both teams.
- Day 10: joint review; decide go/no-go and next billing/scale steps.

Technical integration highlights (for eng)
- Primary integration: Redwood REST + streaming socket for token-by-token responses.
- API surface to use: /v1/generate (streaming) for chat; /v1/embeddings for similarity tests.
- Tool calling: we'll enable function/tool calling on a per-route basis — see SDK guide.

Ownership
- Redwood: Neha (commercial lead), Jordan (technical lead) — Jordan will own env config and rollout policy.
- ByteBridge: Alex (commercial), Priya (engineering contact) — Priya will own the runtime tests and local harness.

Attachments: trial-activation-plan.xlsx (XLSX), redwood-sdk-integration-guide.md (MD), integration-spec-v1.pdf (PDF)

Next steps for Alex/Priya: please confirm acceptance of the timeline and provide the intended test dataset and an engineering contact for VPN/whitelist if needed.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

- We can provide the 50 QA prompts by EOD Monday (Oct 4).
- Priya will be the technical lead; she can be reached at priya.singh@bytebridge.ai.

Alex Nguyen

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T12:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Trial activation & streaming integration — success metrics, ownership, next steps

Looping in engineering notes and proposed owner actions. Short list for internal follow-up before handing to ByteBridge: 

Immediate engineering checklist (Jordan / Dev)
- Provision sandbox key and streaming host: sandbox-us.streaming.redwood.ai (expires in 14 days) — ACTION: Dev to generate and post to secure link.
- Confirm tokenization profiles and sample payload sizes for cost modelling — ACTION: Jordan to run token sample job and share numbers by 10/03.
- Enable function/tool calling on the test route with safe-mode (no outbound HTTP) until review — ACTION: Dev to attach tool policy RBAC.

Evaluation harness & metrics (Marissa)
- We'll provide a nightly summary CSV with latency percentiles and error breakdown.
- Add a gating flag: if error rate >1.5% for two consecutive runs, we pause the trial and investigate.

Deliverables and owners
- Sandbox key + streaming host (Dev)
- SDK quickstart + sample code for WebSocket streaming (Marissa/Jordan)
- Eval prompt pack (ByteBridge)
- Daily results dashboard link (we'll create Grafana share)

I attached minor edits to the activation plan — see integration-spec-v1.pdf (annotated).

-Marissa
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@bytebridge.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Trial activation & streaming integration — technical plan and sample requests

Priya / team — below are the actionable integration steps and minimal snippets to get streaming and tool calling running. We kept the steps lightweight so ByteBridge can be live within 48 hours.

1) Sandbox creds
- I'll post the sandbox API key to the secure link (one-time secret). Key scope: generate.stream, embeddings.read. Expires: 14 days.

2) Streaming route (token-by-token)
- Endpoint (sandbox): wss://sandbox-us.streaming.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=redwood-l1
- Headers: Authorization: Bearer <SANDBOX_KEY>
- Behavior: sends JSON chunks with {token, delta, done:false} and final chunk with done:true.

Minimal WebSocket example (curl + websocat style)
- websocat --header='Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' 'wss://sandbox-us.streaming.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=redwood-l1'
- Send initial JSON: {"input":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":512,"stream":true}

3) REST fallback for batch tests
- POST https://sandbox-us.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
- body: {"input":"...","max_tokens":64}
- this will return full payload (no streaming) useful for throughput/cost runs.

4) Tool calling
- To enable safe tool calling for this trial: include a tools array in the initial request specifying allowed tool names. Example: {"input":"Find user data","tools":["kb_search"],"tool_mode":"sandbox"}
- Our runtime will call the tool via an internal webhook; we will proxy calls back to ByteBridge only when tool_mode=="allowed".

5) Metrics endpoints and artifact export
- We will push daily CSV to the drive link and provide a Grafana read-only dashboard.

6) Sample payloads and token estimates
- Please send 20 representative prompts now; we'll return tokenized size estimates and per-request cost projections within 24h.

Attachments in the secure link: example_websocket_client.js (snippet), integration-spec-v1.pdf (detailed message formats).

If this plan looks good I'll provision the sandbox key and post the secure link.

— Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Trial activation & streaming integration — success metrics, ownership, next steps

Thanks everyone — confirmed. Next steps on our side: 
- Priya will send the 50 QA prompts today.
- We'll run the harness in our staging cluster and aim to start steady-state runs by Oct 5 morning PST.
- Please send the sandbox key and Grafana share once available.

One question: for the tool calling flow, will Redwood log the tool payloads in the trial logs or redact them by default? We need to ensure PII isn't captured.

Otherwise we're ready to proceed. Looking forward to the initial metrics.

Alex
